requiredFindings.title: A latched attempt ledger inside the end charge drops the rollover outcome
requiredFindings.failureScenario: ProjectOperation::end_with builds Ok(RolledOver) after operation_end_after_exhaustion and then returns it from the closure passed to WritePlatformReceipt::charge. That charge is InitialInstallationAttempt::run, which is WorkLedger::scope. Scope returns Ok only while the ledger is open; Ok when closed() is Err(Budget(Closed)), and end_with maps every Err to OperationEnd::Failed. Nested work.run, work.effect, and work.scope set the permanent failed flag before the outer closure resumes. X3b-4 still returns the RolloverOutcome in that case (end_after yields ExhaustedEnd { rollover, end: Ok(NotCopied) } when work.is_failed()). The outer scope discards it. A lease or observe I/O refusal, a failed reservation (journal-x3b r10 item 9), a durability-undetermined rollover (item 13, which must be disclosed as DURABILITY.COMMIT_FAILED), and a copy failure after Rolled { closed, opened } all arrive as Failed(Budget(Closed)), the same row as a budget failure before the rollover ran. Item 4 step 3 and item 13 require the skip or failure to be disclosed on the rollover's own row (X7 r3 item 6). The fence is released and the rollover's lease is dropped; only the value is lost, so a generation that already opened is reported as a closed budget. Required: once operation_end_after_exhaustion has returned, end returns RolledOver carrying that RolloverOutcome, with a copy or unlock failure kept in end and a rollover refusal keeping its own row. A walk, fence, or rebind failure before the call stays Failed and runs no rollover. NotEntered stays the result when the ledger is already closed, or the owner reports Uncertain, before the charge.

scope: X2e with X3b-3 r2, rebase onto 97f630a (v108), RF-1 from r1 fixed, rollover joined through X3b-4. Inventory v111 is ACCEPT on v108: 793 inherited rows, 0 differing, four files added, standings and descriptions name law X3b r10, builder literals match, verify_projection 16 rows and 83 corruptions refused, verify_scratch 76/72/16 with v111 selected on the appended lock. REQUIRED-FINDINGS on the code: WorkLedger::scope inside receipt.charge replaces Ok(RolledOver) with Budget(Closed) after a nested latch, so the rollover outcome is not returned for disclosure. Calls 14, 16 and 17 accepted; call 15 is the finding. Calls 1-13 stay as accepted in r1. Replay of the diff, hunks, inventory, projection verifier, and scratch verifier. Workspace suite, clippy, fmt, rustfmt deltas, check_package_edges, and build_v111.py were not replayed. No product cargo.
